standard_prerequisites.name: The associated points of a coherent module and their finiteness on an affine open
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 1656-1663 and attributed to lemmas of another chapter (cross-chapter pointers)
standard_prerequisites.use: Make the induction on the number of associated points possible.

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard exact sequences and hom descriptions for coherent modules on Noetherian schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Several lemmas of the coherent chapter are invoked in the course of the proof (cross-chapter pointers)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provide the local description of the pushforward and the injectivity checks used in the induction step.

core_obligations: Reduce to affine and finitely many points: the statement being local, the proof assumes the base affine, uses that the set of associated points is then finite, and argues by induction on its size (proof lines 1656-1663)

The induction step: picking a generic point of an irreducible component of the support, the proof relates the given module to the quotient by the corresponding subsheaf and applies the induction hypothesis to the kernel, using the standard exact sequences (proof lines 1663-1710)

Using the hypothesis: the coherence of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the integral subscheme through an associated point is exactly assumption (1), which supplies the missing piece at the crucial step (proof lines 1710-1715)

The converse: the other direction is obtained by exhibiting an injective map from the pushforward of the structure sheaf of that subscheme into the pushforward of the given module (proof lines 1715-1721)
proof_roadmap: 陈述是局部的：设 X 仿射，则 Ass(F) 有限，于是对关联点个数归纳。
取支撑的某个不可约分支的 generic point x，用短正合列把 F 与它商掉、核留给归纳假设；关键一步正好是假设 (1) 给的 j_* i_{x,*} O_{W_x} 的凝聚性。反向由单射 j_*i_{x,*}O → j_*F 得到。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives a criterion for the coherence of a pushforward from an open subscheme in terms of the integral subschemes through the associated points (author lemma at source lines 1642-1654, label lemma-check-finiteness-pushforward-on-associated-points). The proof (source lines 1656-1721) localizes to an affine base, uses finiteness of the set of associated points to argue by induction on its size, splits off one associated point and applies the induction hypothesis to the resulting kernel (proof lines 1663-1710), and then uses assumption (1) exactly at the step where the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the integral subscheme must be coherent; the converse direction is an injectivity argument (proof lines 1715-1721). The induction with the local exact sequences is the content. H2.
